scope: Five Stage 3 meta/process commercial-photo assets and non-canonical landing-section mapping recommendations for the accepted NR-01 route.

exact_prompts.ST3-META-PROMPT-MATRIX-12: Elevated-oblique native 4:3 exact 3x3 matrix, columns raw/base/finished yogurt, rows Thyme Honey/Citrus Peel/Black Sesame; ceramic on stainless, no text/arrows/grid/person/package; show causal material continuity, not validated recipe, with no spirits/lab/apothecary/rustic cues.

claim_gates.rule: Generated photographs are directional visualization, never evidence of actual founder, employee, facility, production run, food safety, recipe or SOP.
Do not publish Fig Leaf as edible-approved until species, plant part, supplier batch, preparation, latex/furanocoumarin risk and applicable-market legality pass explicit review.
Origins, grades, suppliers, harvest stories and quality benefits remain unknown; raw images may identify working ingredients only.
Color, opacity, viscosity, particles, emulsion, separation and finished trace require approved production-tolerant R&D samples before factual caption or final lock.
No generated duration, temperature, pH, dose, yield, shear rate, batch size, equipment tolerance or sanitation claim.
Acid whey appearance does not support nutrition, reuse, upcycling, zero-waste or environmental claims; actual food-safety disposition plan is required.
Generated maker cannot be called founder or employee and does not substantiate handmade, artisan, slow or small-batch claims.

handoff.recommended_action: Use the asset records and mapping recommendations when composing canonical landing materials; preserve claim gates verbatim or stronger.
